slogan.en: One CLI unifies development, builds, testing, linting, and formatting across all your JavaScript projects. Powered by the Rspack ecosystem.
slogan.zh: 只需一个 CLI，即可统一所有 JavaScript 项目的开发、构建、测试、代码检查与格式化。由 Rspack 生态驱动。

appCommandTitle.zh: 从开发到构建，快人一步

appCommandDesc.en: Start a dev server in an instant and build your app for production. Powered by Rsbuild, with the speed of Rspack at every step.
appCommandDesc.zh: 快速启动开发服务器，轻松构建生产应用。基于 Rsbuild，让 Rspack 的速度贯穿整个开发流程。

appCommandHmr.en: Fast feedback with hot module replacement
appCommandHmr.zh: 热模块替换（HMR），即时反馈代码变更

appCommandProduction.en: Optimized production builds powered by Rspack
appCommandProduction.zh: 由 Rspack 驱动，生成优化的生产产物

appCommandConfig.en: One app configuration for development and builds
appCommandConfig.zh: 开发与构建，共用一份应用配置

libCommandDesc.en: Build JavaScript and TypeScript libraries with Rslib. From reusable utilities to component libraries, bring your code to more projects.
libCommandDesc.zh: 使用 Rslib 构建 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 库。从通用工具到组件库，让你的代码在更多项目中复用。

libCommandFormats.en: Flexible output formats, including ESM and CommonJS
libCommandFormats.zh: 灵活的产物格式，支持 ESM 和 CommonJS

libCommandTypes.zh: 通过 --dts 生成 TypeScript 类型声明

libCommandWatch.zh: 通过 --watch 监听变更，自动重新构建

testCommandTitle.en: Test as fast as you build

testCommandDesc.en: Run your tests with Rstest and keep feedback close to your code. Share your build settings and move from local development to CI with ease.
testCommandDesc.zh: 使用 Rstest 运行测试，及时获得代码反馈。复用构建配置，让测试从本地开发顺畅延伸到 CI。

testCommandConfig.en: Automatically inherit app or library configuration
testCommandConfig.zh: 自动继承应用或库的配置

testCommandWatch.en: Rerun related tests as your code changes
testCommandWatch.zh: 代码变更时，自动重新运行相关测试

testCommandCoverage.en: Collect coverage locally or run once in CI
testCommandCoverage.zh: 支持覆盖率收集和适用于 CI 的单次运行

checkCommandTitle.zh: 一个命令，保持代码一致

checkCommandDesc.en: Run lint and formatting checks together, with optional TypeScript type checking. Keep your existing code style with support for Prettier options and plugins.
checkCommandDesc.zh: 一次完成代码检查与格式校验，按需启用 TypeScript 类型检查。兼容 Prettier 的格式化选项与插件，延续现有代码风格。

checkCommandTypes.en: Type-aware linting, with optional type checking
checkCommandTypes.zh: 支持类型感知的代码检查，按需启用类型检查

checkCommandFormat.en: Parallel formatting with a persistent cache
checkCommandFormat.zh: 并行格式化与持久化缓存，加速重复运行

checkCommandFix.en: Apply lint and formatting fixes with rs check --fix
checkCommandFix.zh: 通过 rs check --fix 自动修复代码与格式问题

hooksCommandTitle.zh: 让每次提交，都经过检查

hooksCommandDesc.en: Automatically check and format staged files before committing. Reuse lint-staged task configuration and migrate your existing Git Hooks workflow from Husky.
hooksCommandDesc.zh: 在提交前自动检查和格式化暂存文件。支持 lint-staged 的任务配置，可从 Husky 迁移现有 Git Hooks 工作流。

hooksCommandSetup.en: Manage Git hooks for the whole repository
hooksCommandSetup.zh: 统一管理整个仓库的 Git Hooks

hooksCommandStaged.en: Run checks on staged files before committing
hooksCommandStaged.zh: 提交前，针对暂存文件运行检查

hooksCommandTasks.en: Configure lint, format, and custom tasks by file pattern
hooksCommandTasks.zh: 按文件模式配置检查、格式化及自定义任务

docCommandDesc.en: Turn your content into a documentation site with Rspress. Keep your docs alongside your code, with one configuration for the whole workflow.
docCommandDesc.zh: 使用 Rspress 将内容构建为文档站点。让文档与代码一同维护，通过统一配置串联完整工作流。

docCommandMarkdown.en: Write in Markdown and add React components with MDX
docCommandMarkdown.zh: 使用 Markdown 编写文档，通过 MDX 嵌入 React 组件

docCommandFeatures.zh: 内置全文搜索，支持多语言文档

docCommandWorkflow.en: Develop, build, and preview with one CLI
docCommandWorkflow.zh: 通过统一命令行完成开发、构建与预览
